text:
deploy-bot: Packaging job started for private-vpc bundle v2026.03. Marking shrinkwrap + transport manifest for staging canary. artifacts: gs://redwood-packages/private/v2026.03/shrinkwrap.tar.gz :package: 

pkg_dave: quick heads-up: I pushed the signed submanifest to staging and uploaded cosign sigs. please verify checksums before windows.

kevin: grabbing checksums now. can someone confirm KMS key id for cosign? last rotation changed key alias.

pkg_dave: using projects/redwood-kms/keys/prod-cosign-key (rotated 2026-02-20). cosign sigs made with key version v3.

dana: running verify locally:
```
cosign verify-blob --key ksm://projects/redwood-kms/keys/prod-cosign-key:v3 \  
  --signature shrinkwrap.tar.gz.sig shrinkwrap.tar.gz
sha256sum shrinkwrap.tar.gz
```
kevin: verify passed, sha256 = 3f7a2b9d5a6c1e4f8b1f2c3d4e5f6789a0b1c2d3e4f5a6b7c8d9e0f1a2b3c4d

elaine: thumbs. I've updated the release-notes draft with the private-VPC caveats and required manifests (link: https://redwood.example.com/releases/2026-03-vpc-bundle). please review network preflight note.

sam: rollout plan? what’s the canary window length and pin strategy?

deploy-bot: Canary window scheduled: 90m starting 2026-03-09T22:00:00Z. Model-serving pods pinned to digest for canary group only. Full rollout at T+3h if no regressions. Automatic rollback rule: if error rate > 3% for 10m or median p95 latency regress > 40%.

ops_jess: I'll watch SLOs during the canary. tagging @oncall for the window. please also leave the older sealed bundle (v2026.02) available as immediate fallback.

pkg_dave: note: transport manifest contains per-region mirror pointers. we set retry=3 and ttl=48h for signature checks to avoid transient KMS latencies.

kevin: one ops question: do we need to pin kernel modules or is the image shrinkwrap self-contained?

pkg_dave: shrinkwrap includes kernel-modules.tar.gz checksum and leverages preflight.sh to verify kernel ABI compatibility. if preflight fails, deploy-bot will abort and mark for manual rollback.

dana: small ask — can we add a short snippet in release notes showing the cosign verify command and the public key fingerprint so customers can validate?

elaine: added that snippet and a short troubleshooting section: KMS time skew, cosign timeout, missing mirror objects.

sam: rollback procedure clarified? need a playbook link in thread.

pkg_dave: rollback playbook: 1) pin manifest to sealed bundle digest (v2026.02), 2) trigger transport-evict for mirrors to remove v2026.03 partials, 3) notify customers via status page and send follow-up notes. playbook link: https://confluence.redwood.internal/release-playbooks/vpc-rollback

deploy-bot: Preflight checks passing (all 18). Preflight log: https://storage.redwood.internal/preflight/1709998765.log

ops_jess: cool. I'll be on watch for the first 3h. if we hit the rollback criteria, I'll run the pinned-manifest swap and confirm TLS/transport integrity.

kevin: ETA for the manifest pin and signature TTL confirmation?

pkg_dave: I've extended signature TTL on the sealed manifest to 7d and left canary pins only for 3h. full rollout pins the new digest in all mirrors.

dana: tiny nit — add a note about customer on-prem proxies that might cache the manifest; include steps to force-refresh caches during cutover. added to playbook.

sam: ack. all good from infra side. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Canary starting in 15m. will post status updates. :rocket:
